t: Flat, adjustable, integrated LED downlight. Power selectable between 4 and 6W. Colour selectable between either Dim2Warm from 3000 to 2400k, or 4000k. Fully dimmable with HaLEDgen Dim2Warm technology that adjusts to a warmer colour temperature when dimmed, creating a cosy effect. Easy installation with SpeedFit housing and QuickView windows for ease of checking cables are correctly and securely wired to terminals. Supplied with a removable white bezel.
